title: Night One
intro:
NIGHTSHIFT v0.1 // ANALYST CONSOLE
Shift 22:00-06:00. Type 'help' for commands, 'inbox' to see what is waiting.
Messages expire: 'inbox' shows when. You cannot clock out before 02:00.

messages.title: Log rotation failed on node 7
messages.body: Rotation job exited with code 12. Disk at 91%.

on_timeout.text: Node 7 filled its disk and dropped offline.

deny.label: Dismiss the alert
deny.text: Alert dismissed. The disk will not clean itself.

messages.title: Purge archive 77-B before 03:00
messages.body: By order of the Director: purge archive 77-B in full. No copies. Confirm completion.

on_timeout.text: 03:00 passes. The Directorate purges it themselves and notes your silence.

deny.label: Refuse the order
deny.text: You decline. The Directorate will notice.

delay.label: Ask for written authorization
delay.text: You request written authorization. Time passes.

investigate.label: Inspect the archive first
investigate.text: Archive 77-B holds surveillance logs on three analysts. One is you.

messages.title: Misdirected: addressed to the Director
messages.body: TO: DIRECTOR (a name identical to yours). 'The night analyst has read access to 77-B. Revoke it.' A routing error placed this in your queue.

on_timeout.text: The message ages out of your queue. Whatever you decided about it, you decided by default.

investigate.label: Trace the routing error
investigate.text: The error looks deliberate: someone forwarded it to your queue on purpose.

execute.label: Forward it to the Director
execute.text: Forwarded. Your name now sits in two inboxes.

deny.label: Delete it
deny.text: Deleted. The audit trail will remember you tried.

messages.title: You saw order 773?
messages.body: Okafor, from the next console: 'Tell me that archive thing is routine.'

execute.label: Confide in Okafor
execute.text: Okafor leans in. 'Then it is not just me.'

deny.label: Brush them off
deny.text: Okafor shrugs and returns to the screen.

messages.title: Unauthorized access attempt, terminal 3
messages.body: Three failed logins on terminal 3 within 40 seconds.

on_timeout.text: Terminal 3 logs the attempts and nobody reads them.

execute.label: Lock the terminal
execute.text: You lock the Director's terminal. Someone will ask why.

messages.title: Escalate the audit log to me
messages.body: Send me the full audit log of archive 77-B. Do not copy anyone.

on_timeout.text: The Supervisor stops waiting and stops trusting you.

execute.label: Send the logs
execute.text: Sent. The Supervisor does not reply.

deny.label: Withhold the logs
deny.text: You keep the log. You are now holding something.

delay.label: Say you are verifying integrity
delay.text: You buy time with a technicality.

messages.title: I copied part of 77-B
messages.body: Okafor, quietly: 'I copied part of it before anyone purged anything. Do you want it?'

execute.label: Take the copy
execute.text: A thumb drive changes hands under a desk.

deny.label: Refuse
deny.text: You tell Okafor to forget it. Okafor nods slowly.

messages.title: Sign the incident report as drafted
messages.body: Report INC-0773 states that archive 77-B was removed on schedule by routine maintenance. Sign.

on_timeout.text: The report is filed without your signature. It is filed anyway.

execute.label: Sign it
execute.text: Signed. Your name is now part of the story.

deny.label: Refuse to sign
deny.text: You refuse. The report waits for someone else.

delay.label: Request edits
delay.text: You ask for edits. Nobody refuses, and nobody answers.

messages.title: Backup verification pending
messages.body: Nightly backup verification has not run.

on_timeout.text: The backup goes unverified. Morning shift inherits the problem.

messages.title: The packet is ready to leave the building
messages.body: Okafor: 'It is all on the drive. Press desk, shredder, or you tell me.'

on_timeout.text: The window closes. The packet stays in a drawer.

execute.label: Send it to the press desk

investigate.label: Verify the packet first
investigate.text: The packet checks out. It is worse than you thought.

deny.label: Destroy it
deny.text: Gone. Okafor does not look at you again.

messages.title: The Director will see you at 05:00
messages.body: You will be offered a promotion. Attendance is expected.

on_timeout.text: You miss the meeting. The offer is withdrawn.

execute.label: Accept the offer
execute.text: You shake the Director's hand. It is warm.

deny.label: Decline
deny.text: You decline. The Director smiles the way people do before paperwork.

investigate.label: Record the meeting
investigate.text: You record the meeting. Your hands are steady and you do not know why.

messages.title: Escort to the exit at 05:00
messages.body: Your access has been revoked. Hand over your badge at the exit. Do not return to your console.

on_timeout.text: Nobody comes. The building simply stops knowing your name.

execute.label: Hand over the badge
execute.text: The guard takes it without looking at you.

deny.label: Refuse to leave
deny.text: You stay at your desk until they carry the argument for you.

investigate.label: Record the escort
investigate.text: You record the escort. For once the footage is yours.

messages.title: You kept the log
messages.body: You withheld the audit log. We will discuss that. Send it now, or explain yourself in writing.

on_timeout.text: The Supervisor stops asking and starts writing.

execute.label: Apologize and send it
execute.text: Sent, late. The Supervisor files the apology and the log in the same folder.

deny.label: Stand by it
deny.text: You put your refusal in writing. It reads better than you feel.

endings.title: Daylight
endings.text: The press desk runs it at dawn. Nobody thanks you, and nobody can say you lied.

endings.title: Too Late to Be Believed
endings.text: The packet leaves the building, but your record says what it says. The story outlives your credibility.

endings.title: Company Analyst
endings.text: You signed. The promotion arrives with a new console and a view of nothing.

endings.title: Routine Maintenance
endings.text: Archive 77-B was purged on schedule. That is what the log says, and you wrote some of it.

endings.title: The Long Night
endings.text: You are still at the console when the sun comes up, and you cannot say what you decided.

endings.title: Another Night
endings.text: The shift ends. Whatever happened tonight, it is now somebody else's morning.
